# ShastraLab

> AI-powered answer evaluation platform that helps UPSC and state PSC aspirants write examiner-ready answers through structured feedback inspired by the Indian Shastra tradition.

ShastraLab evaluates handwritten and typed answers using an AI examiner framework, providing structure, relevance, and depth feedback. Aspirants upload answers, receive scored feedback, and track progress over time.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of ShastraLab and its Shastra-inspired evaluation framework.
- [Sign In](/auth): Authentication for aspirants.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Personal practice dashboard and progress overview.
- [Syllabi](/syllabi): Browse exam syllabi for UPSC and state PSC.
- [Analyze Paper](/analyze): Upload and analyze a single question paper.
- [Batch Analyze](/batch-analyze): Upload multiple papers for bulk analysis.
- [Compare Papers](/compare): Side-by-side comparison of question papers.
- [Year Trends](/year-over-year): Year-over-year topic and question trend analysis.
- [Written Practice](/written-practice): Submit handwritten or typed answers for AI evaluation.
- [Timed Mock Test](/mock-test): Take timed mock tests under exam conditions.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Aspirant rankings and performance.
- [Achievements](/achievements): Earn badges for milestones.
- [My Progress](/submission-history): History of submitted answers and scores.
- [Question Bank](/questions): Browse curated practice questions.
- [Reports](/reports): Detailed performance reports.
